abstract: This paper investigates the importance of the age composition for pandemic policy design. To do so, it introduces an economic framework with age heterogeneity, individual choice, and incomplete information, emphasizing the value of testing. Calibrating the model to the US Covid-19 pandemic reveals an 80% reduction in the death toll due to voluntary actions and the lockdown implemented in the US. The optimal lockdown, however, is more stringent than what was implemented. Moreover, the social planner follows an asymmetric approach by locking down the young relatively more than the old. We highlight the role of testing in reducing deaths, lowering economic costs, and allowing for a less restrictive lockdown. A social planner would choose a faster ramp-up in testing capacity relative to what occurred in the US. We use the framework to provide insights into pandemics caused by different viruses (including the Spanish flu), and underline the influence of economic conditions on optimal policies.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了年龄结构在疫情政策设计中的重要性。为此，引入了一个包含年龄异质性、个体选择及信息不完全的经济框架，并强调了检测的价值。通过将模型校准至美国新冠疫情数据，发现自愿行动与美国实施的封锁措施使死亡人数减少了80%。
title: Optimal Age-based Policies for Pandemics: An Economic Analysis of Covid-19 and Beyond
title_zh: 疫情最优年龄分层政策：基于新冠疫情及未来的经济学分析

abstract: Poverty alleviation relocation is an important component of China's anti‐poverty strategy and has reshaped relocated households' living conditions and social integration. Using the Poverty Alleviation Relocation Programme (PARP) as a quasi‐natural experiment, this study examines the impact of relocation on households' social status based on four‐wave panel data from 1351 households. The results show that relocation significantly improves subjective social status, whereas its effect on objective social status is insignificant. The positive effect is more pronounced among young adults aged 18–44, elderly individuals aged 60 and above, households with lower educational attainment, and those resettled in rural areas. Mechanism analysis suggests that social network expansion and improved life satisfaction are important channels through which relocation enhances perceived social standing. The findings also reveal a significant increase in conspicuous consumption after relocation, suggesting stronger aspirations for upward mobility among relocated households. By extending the analysis from material welfare to the social dimensions of relocation, this study provides new evidence on the social consequences of poverty alleviation relocation and offers implications for subsequent support policies.
abstract_zh: 易地扶贫搬迁是中国反贫困战略的重要组成部分，重塑了搬迁家庭的生活条件与社会融合。本研究以易地扶贫搬迁项目作为准自然实验，基于1351户家庭的四轮面板数据，考察了搬迁对家庭社会地位的影响。结果表明，搬迁显著提升了主观社会地位，而对客观社会地位的影响则不显著。这一积极效应在18至44岁的青年群体、60岁及以上的老年群体、受教育程度较低的家庭以及迁入农村地区的家庭中更为明显。机制分析表明，社交网络扩展和生活满意度提升是搬迁增强感知社会地位的重要渠道。研究结果还显示，搬迁后炫耀性消费显著增加，表明搬迁家庭具有更强的向上流动意愿。通过将分析从物质福利延伸至搬迁的社会维度，本研究为易地扶贫搬迁的社会后果提供了新的证据，并对后续支持政策具有启示意义。

title: Where the Heart Finds Peace, There Is My Home: Changes in Social Status in the Poverty Alleviation Relocation Programme

abstract: This paper presents an analytical heterogeneous agent model (HAM) to explore micro-level concentration dynamics and their effects on macro-level distribution and growth. It contributes to recent work on macroeconomic agent-based models (ABMs) by comparing a small-scale ABM with bilateral firm-customer matching to a simplified HAM without direct agent interactions. The HAM replicates key ABM results while allowing for analytical solutions. In the model, larger firms benefit from lower unit costs due to economies of scale, gain larger market shares, and set higher markups. More profitable firms temporarily grow faster, leading to endogenous changes in the firm size distribution. The resulting right-skewed distributions create a divergence between the average profit share across firms and the aggregate profit share, which is driven by the largest firms. The decline in the labour share reduces aggregate consumption and slows growth. Despite its simplicity, the model captures key empirical patterns related to superstar firms and declining labour shares.
abstract_zh: 本文构建了一个分析性异质主体模型（HAM），旨在探究微观层面的集中动态及其对宏观分配与增长的影响。该研究通过将一个小规模、具有双边企业-客户匹配的基于主体的模型（ABM）与一个简化、无直接主体互动的HAM进行对比，为近期宏观经济基于主体模型的研究做出了贡献。HAM在允许解析解的同时，复现了ABM的关键结果。在该模型中，规模较大的企业因规模经济而享有较低的单位成本，获得更大的市场份额，并设定更高的加成率。盈利能力更强的企业暂时增长更快，导致企业规模分布发生内生变化。由此产生的右偏分布造成了企业间平均利润份额与总体利润份额之间的差异，后者由最大型企业主导。劳动份额的下降减少了总消费并减缓了增长。尽管模型简洁，它仍捕捉到了与超级明星企业和劳动份额下降相关的主要经验模式。
journal: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
source_issue: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
title: An analytical heterogeneous agent macro model of concentration, markups, and falling labour shares
title_zh: 集中度、加成率与劳动份额下降的分析性异质主体宏观模型

abstract: Improving public service quality is a central challenge in developing countries. A common policy tool is to transfer expertise and protocols to lower-tier institutions, with the expectation that such spillovers improve both current performance and long-term innovative capacity. We study this policy logic using a Chinese reform that mandated knowledge transfer from elite to lower-tier hospitals. Our analysis combines a novel measure of lower-tier hospitals’ alignment with elite hospitals’ clinical practice, developed with a large language model applied to clinical texts and prescription decisions, with measures of physicians’ exploratory activity based on academic publications. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that the policy increased practice alignment at targeted hospitals by 0.29 standard deviations, yielding immediate efficiency gains. At the same time, this gain in exploitation was accompanied by a decline in exploration: physician academic output fell, with publication counts declining by 7% and citation impact by 13%. Our findings highlight that policies promoting existing knowledge can close practice gaps and improve care efficiency, while also creating a potential trade-off with professionals’ incentives to generate new knowledge.
abstract_zh: 提升公共服务质量是发展中国家面临的核心挑战。一个常见的政策工具是将专业知识与操作规程向低层级机构转移，预期此类溢出效应既能改善当前绩效，也能增强长期创新能力。我们利用中国一项要求从精英医院向低层级医院进行知识转移的改革来研究这一政策逻辑。我们的分析结合了一种新颖的低层级医院与精英医院临床实践一致性度量方法——该方法基于大型语言模型对临床文本和处方决策的应用——以及基于学术论文的医生探索性活动度量。采用双重差分设计，我们发现该政策使目标医院的实践一致性提高了0.29个标准差，带来了即时的效率提升。与此同时，这种利用性收益伴随着探索性的下降：医生的学术产出减少，论文发表数量下降7%，引用影响力下降13%。我们的研究结果表明，促进现有知识传播的政策能够缩小实践差距并提高医疗效率，同时也可能与专业人员创造新知识的激励形成潜在权衡。
china_relevance_reason: 研究基于中国医院改革政策，使用中国医院数据，核心研究对象为中国医疗机构和医生，属于中国研究。
title: Exploitation vs. Exploration: How knowledge spillovers shape healthcare practices and innovation
title_zh: 剥削与探索：知识溢出如何塑造医疗实践与创新

abstract: Boys are less likely than girls to enter college, a gap that is often attributed to a lack of non-cognitive skills such as motivation and self-discipline.We study how being classified as gifted -determined by having an IQ score of 116 or higher -affects college entry rates of disadvantaged children in a large urban school district.For boys with IQ's around the cutoff, gifted identification raises the college entry rate by 25-30 percentage points -enough to catch up with girls in the same IQ range.In contrast, we find small effects for girls.Looking at course-taking and grade outcomes in middle and high school, we find large effects of gifted status for boys that close most of the gaps with girls, but no detectable effects on standardized tests scores of either gender.Overall, we interpret the evidence as demonstrating that gifted services raise the non-cognitive skills of boys conditional on their cognitive skills, leading to gains in educational attainment.
abstract_zh: 男孩进入大学的比例低于女孩，这一差距常被归因于缺乏动机和自律等非认知技能。我们研究在一个大型城市学区中，被认定为资优——依据智商分数达到116或以上——如何影响弱势儿童的大学入学率。对于智商接近临界值的男孩，资优认定将大学入学率提高了25至30个百分点——足以赶上同智商范围内的女孩。相比之下，我们发现对女孩的影响较小。通过考察初中和高中的课程选择及成绩结果，我们发现资优身份对男孩有显著影响，缩小了与女孩之间的大部分差距，但对两性的标准化测试成绩均无可检测的影响。总体而言，我们将证据解读为表明，资优服务在认知技能不变的情况下提升了男孩的非认知技能，从而带来了教育成就上的收益。
title: Can Gifted Education Help Higher-Ability Boys from Disadvantaged Backgrounds?
title_zh: 天才教育能否帮助来自弱势背景的高能力男孩？

abstract: This paper examines the resilience of city structure to a large shock and its underlying economic mechanisms. We analyze the atomic bombing of Hiroshima, which was an exogenous shock that leveled the city center but not its periphery, by combining newly digitized data with a dynamic quantitative urban model. We first construct spatially granular data within Hiroshima and document the resilience: the city center recovered just about five years after being destroyed. Importantly, we also show that the recovery of the city center is not necessarily explained by its fundamental locational characteristics. We then develop a novel dynamic urban economics model that allows us to disentangle the mechanisms underlying the recovery. Our calibrated model finds that strong agglomeration forces, together with individuals’ expectations of the recovery, created a strong incentive to rebuild the city center quickly despite the catastrophic shock.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了城市结构在面对重大冲击时的韧性及其背后的经济机制。我们以广岛原子弹爆炸为例，这一外生冲击夷平了城市中心但未波及周边区域，通过结合新数字化数据与动态定量城市模型进行分析。我们首先构建了广岛内部空间粒度数据，并记录了其韧性表现：城市中心在被摧毁后仅约五年便得以恢复。重要的是，我们还表明，城市中心的恢复并不必然由其基础区位特征所解释。随后，我们开发了一个新颖的动态城市经济学模型，以厘清恢复背后的机制。校准模型发现，强大的集聚力量，加之个体对恢复的预期，共同构成了在灾难性冲击后迅速重建城市中心的强烈激励。
title: The Economic Dynamics of City Structure: Evidence from Hiroshima's Recovery
title_zh: 城市结构的经济动态：来自广岛重建的证据

abstract: Land use conflicts in cultural landscapes are difficult to detect under strict spatial regulation, yet they may substantially affect landscape sustainability. This study introduces a landscape multifunctionality framework to identify potential land use conflicts as spatial competition generated by the co-location and interaction of multiple landscape functions. The framework was applied to the Mulanbei Irrigation Area in Putian, China. Using historical land-cover maps, content analysis, seven representative functions across ecological, productive, social, and cultural dimensions were identified and mapped. We examined land use change, functional gains and losses, trade-offs and synergies, and landscape pattern to identify potential land use conflict zones and classify the levels of potential land use conflicts. The results indicate that land use change from 2014 to 2022 was limited overall, but spatially constrained. Construction land increased by 19.64 km² (+17.18%), mainly at the expense of cropland and water bodies, while cropland decreased by 14.67 km² and water bodies declined by 29.93%. Leisure and recreation increased by 101.41%, while food supply, habitat maintenance, and carbon sequestration decreased by 13.41%, 7.71%, and 5.76%. Potential conflict zones remained scattered, but ecological-cultural trade-offs were associated with broader spatial extent and higher conflict levels. The highest conflict level occurred in water bodies, followed by cropland and woodland, reflecting intensified riparian functional mixing, cropland trade-offs between grain production and multifunctional use, and the role of woodland in limiting ecological loss. These findings support periodic assessment, place-specific governance, and complementary functional networks for heritage conservation and adaptive development.
abstract_zh: 文化景观中的土地利用冲突在严格的空间规制下难以被察觉，然而它们可能对景观可持续性产生重大影响。本研究引入景观多功能性框架，将潜在的土地利用冲突识别为多种景观功能在空间上共存与相互作用所产生的空间竞争。该框架应用于中国莆田木兰陂灌区。利用历史土地覆盖图、内容分析等方法，识别并绘制了涵盖生态、生产、社会和文化维度的七项代表性功能。我们考察了土地利用变化、功能增益与损失、权衡与协同关系以及景观格局，以识别潜在的土地利用冲突区域，并对潜在冲突水平进行分级。结果表明，2014年至2022年间土地利用变化总体有限，但在空间上受到约束。建设用地增加了19.64平方公里（+17.18%），主要占用耕地和水体，而耕地减少了14.67平方公里，水体减少了29.93%。休闲娱乐功能增加了101.41%，而食物供给、栖息地维护和碳固存功能分别下降了13.41%、7.71%和5.76%。潜在冲突区域保持分散分布，但生态-文化权衡与更广泛的空间范围和更高的冲突水平相关联。最高冲突水平出现在水体，其次是耕地和林地，反映出河岸功能混合加剧、耕地在粮食生产与多功能利用之间的权衡，以及林地在限制生态损失方面的作用。这些发现为遗产保护与适应性发展的周期性评估、因地制宜的治理以及互补性功能网络构建提供了支持。

title: Integrating landscape multifunctionality into the identification of potential land use conflict zones in cultural landscapes

abstract: This study examines the potential impact of introducing a transfer system, similar to that used in professional soccer, into the standard labor market. We develop a toy model highlighting the theoretical properties of transfer fees. We show that, unlike non-compete clauses—which generate a trade-off between training and mobility—transfer fees encourage investment in training while preserving efficient mobility toward more productive firms. As a result, such a system brings the economy closer to the social optimum than laissez-faire. We then construct a life-cycle model featuring endogenous job creation and destruction, on-the-job search, and training. Using data from the French Labor Force Survey, we estimate the model’s parameters and conduct counterfactual experiments. Our simulations suggest that a time-limited compensation mechanism would significantly increase employment, training access, and welfare.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了将职业足球中采用的转会制度引入标准劳动力市场可能产生的影响。我们构建了一个简化模型，以阐明转会费的理论特性。研究表明，与在培训与流动性之间产生权衡的非竞争条款不同，转会费在鼓励培训投资的同时，保持了向更具生产力企业流动的高效性。因此，此类制度使经济比自由放任状态更接近社会最优水平。随后，我们构建了一个包含内生就业创造与毁灭、在职搜索及培训的生命周期模型。利用法国劳动力调查数据，我们估计了模型参数并进行了反事实实验。模拟结果显示，一种限时补偿机制将显著提升就业率、培训机会及社会福利。
journal: Journal of the European Economic Association
title: Training and Job-to-Job Mobility with Transfer Fees,
title_zh: 培训与工作间流动中的转移费用

abstract: Changes in transport costs can affect mobility in ways that differ across the population, affecting the impacts of transport policies. We randomly assign large price reductions on Uber in Egypt over a 3-month period and collect comprehensive data on participant mobility using Google Timeline. A 50% price reduction quadruples Uber usage and induces a 42% increase in total travel. Effects and welfare gains are larger for women, who are less mobile at baseline and perceive public transit as unsafe. The price elasticity of private vehicle kilometers traveled (-1.28) implies that mobility and external costs increase substantially when ride-hailing prices fall.
abstract_zh: 运输成本的变化可能以不同方式影响不同人群的流动性，从而影响交通政策的效应。我们在埃及对Uber实施为期三个月的大幅降价随机分配，并利用Google Timeline收集参与者流动性的全面数据。降价50%使Uber使用量翻两番，并导致总出行量增加42%。对于基线流动性较低且认为公共交通不安全的女性，其影响和福利收益更为显著。私人车辆行驶公里数的价格弹性（-1.28）表明，当网约车价格下降时，流动性和外部成本会大幅增加。
title: The Demand for Mobility: Evidence From an Experiment With Uber Riders
title_zh: 出行需求：来自优步乘客实验的证据

abstract: In the cardinal part of their analysis of spherical preferences, Chambers and Echenique (2020) characterise quadratic-plus-linear utility using two axioms concerning changes from a status quo: Status Quo Independence (SQI) and Eventual Linearity (EL). We show that the two axioms are not independent. Specifically, SQI implies EL and, indeed, forces the additivity condition in EL to hold at every status quo, not merely at some status quo. Consequently, under continuity and normalisation, SQI alone characterises the representation, implying that their cardinal theorem remains valid when EL is dropped. The respective roles of continuity and normalisation are also clarified.
abstract_zh: 在Chambers和Echenique（2020）对球形偏好基数部分的分析中，他们通过两个关于现状变化的公理——现状独立性（SQI）和最终线性（EL）——来刻画二次加线性效用。我们证明这两个公理并非独立。具体而言，SQI蕴含EL，并且实际上迫使EL中的可加性条件在每个现状下都成立，而不仅仅是在某些现状下。因此，在连续性和归一化条件下，仅凭SQI即可刻画该表示，这意味着他们的基数定理在省略EL时依然有效。同时，我们也澄清了连续性和归一化各自的作用。
title: A single-axiom cardinal characterisation of quadratic utility
title_zh: 二次效用单一公理基数特征刻画

abstract: This paper reviews firm-level data on artificial intelligence and the emerging evidence on AI's economic effects. It argues that measurement is central: different AI datasets capture different objects (including invention versus use, internal capability building versus outsourcing, and realized activity versus investor perceptions) and can therefore lead to different conclusions. The paper develops a framework for choosing among these measures and surveys available data sources on firm AI efforts. It synthesizes evidence on AI's effects on firm growth, valuation, productivity, risk, labor, competition, financial markets and applications. The paper concludes by suggesting some ideas for future research.
abstract_zh: 本文回顾了企业层面的人工智能数据及关于AI经济影响的新兴证据。文章强调测量至关重要：不同的AI数据集捕捉不同的对象（包括发明与使用、内部能力建设与外包、实际活动与投资者认知），因此可能导致不同的结论。本文构建了一个选择这些测量指标的框架，并调查了关于企业AI努力的现有数据来源。文章综合了AI对企业增长、估值、生产率、风险、劳动力、竞争、金融市场及应用方面影响的证据。最后，本文提出了一些未来研究方向的建议。
title: Understanding Firms' AI Efforts and Their Economic Impact
title_zh: 理解企业人工智能投入及其经济影响

abstract: We investigate how individuals interpret corporate sustainability disclosures in a pre-registered survey experiment. We provide novel evidence that participants can meaningfully distinguish greener from browner firms, yet their assessments exhibit a central tendency bias. Interestingly, this bias is asymmetric: respondents overestimate the greenness of browner firms while underestimating the greenness of greener firms more strongly. The same pattern persists among finance professionals and sustainability experts, suggesting that expertise alone does not eliminate interpretation errors. Consequently, firms’ incentives to invest in emissions reductions may be attenuated. We further identify disclosure design features that enhance individuals’ ability to differentiate firms’ emissions performance.
abstract_zh: 我们通过一项预注册的问卷调查实验，探究个体如何解读企业可持续发展披露信息。我们提供了新颖的证据，表明参与者能够有意义地区分更环保与更不环保的企业，然而其评估存在中心趋势偏差。有趣的是，这种偏差具有不对称性：受访者高估了较不环保企业的绿色程度，同时更显著地低估了更环保企业的绿色程度。这一模式在金融专业人士和可持续发展专家中同样存在，表明专业知识本身并不能消除解读错误。因此，企业投资于减排的激励可能被削弱。我们进一步识别出能够增强个体区分企业排放绩效能力的披露设计特征。
china_relevance_reason: 研究基于预注册调查实验，探讨个体如何解读企业可持续披露信息，未涉及中国数据、制度或政策背景，核心应用亦非中国情境。
title: Objective vs. Perceived Corporate Greenness: Do Individuals Understand Corporate Sustainability Information?
title_zh: 客观绿色度与感知绿色度：个体能否理解企业可持续信息？

abstract: Digital finance is reshaping financial institutions, but its relationship with efficiency remains unclear. This study examines whether regional digital insurance development is associated with the efficiency of Chinese insurers. Using an unbalanced panel from 2016 to 2023, efficiency is estimated by data envelopment analysis (DEA) efficiency scores, while regional digital insurance exposure is constructed from provincial digital insurance development and insurers’ geographic premium distribution. The results show no significant contemporaneous or nonlinear association, whereas one-year-lagged exposure is positively associated with efficiency. The clearest channel-consistent evidence appears on the asset side, where lagged exposure is positively related to investment returns, which are associated with efficiency. Liability-side indicators provide limited support, and the lagged coefficient does not differ significantly across insurer types. The findings are robust to an alternative efficiency measure, Tobit estimators, a longer lag and a lead placebo. Overall, regional digital insurance development appears to be an enabling condition whose efficiency implications emerge over time. KEYWORDS: Digital finance digital insurance exposure operating efficiency insurance firms data envelopment analysis JEL CLASSIFICATION: G22 O33 C14
abstract_zh: 数字金融正在重塑金融机构，但其与效率之间的关系仍不明确。本研究考察区域数字保险发展是否与中国保险公司的效率相关。利用2016年至2023年的非平衡面板数据，通过数据包络分析（DEA）效率得分估算效率，同时基于省级数字保险发展及保险公司地理保费分布构建区域数字保险暴露指标。结果显示，当期暴露与效率之间不存在显著的同期或非线性关联，而滞后一年的暴露与效率呈正相关。最清晰的渠道一致性证据出现在资产端，滞后暴露与投资回报正相关，而投资回报又与效率相关。负债端指标提供的支持有限，且滞后系数在不同类型保险公司之间无显著差异。上述发现在替代效率度量、Tobit估计、更长滞后期及前置安慰剂检验下均保持稳健。总体而言，区域数字保险发展似乎是一种赋能条件，其对效率的影响随时间逐步显现。关键词：数字金融；数字保险暴露；经营效率；保险公司；数据包络分析 JEL分类：G22 O33 C14
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Digital insurance development and firm operating efficiency: evidence from Chinese insurers
title_zh: 数字保险发展与企业经营效率：来自中国保险公司的证据

abstract: In cooperative games with transferable utility (TU-games), a player’s contribution may vary depending on the coalition they join, reflecting different levels of synergy with other members. In this paper, we introduce a family of axioms referred to as sub-game order preservation axioms , which formalize the intuition that a player’s payoff should increase with the degree of synergy they exhibit within a coalition. We propose four distinct axioms, each of which captures a different interpretation of what constitutes synergy in the context of TU-games. We demonstrate that one of these variants is incompatible with the classical Efficiency axiom, thereby giving rise to an impossibility result. The remaining three axioms, when combined with Efficiency, lead to unique characterizations of three well-known solution concepts: the Shapley value, the Center of the imputation set (CIS), and the Equal allocation of non-separable contributions (ENSC) value, respectively.
abstract_zh: 在具有可转移效用的合作博弈（TU博弈）中，参与者的贡献可能因其加入的联盟不同而有所变化，这反映了与其他成员之间不同程度的协同效应。本文引入了一组公理，称为子博弈序保持公理，这些公理形式化了参与者的收益应随其在联盟中展现的协同程度增加而提高的直觉。我们提出了四个不同的公理，每个公理都捕捉了TU博弈背景下协同概念的不同解释。我们证明，其中一个变体与经典的效率公理不相容，从而产生了一个不可能性结果。其余三个公理在与效率公理结合时，分别导致了对三个著名解概念的独特刻画：沙普利值、分配集中心（CIS）以及不可分离贡献的均等分配（ENSC）值。
title: Sub-game order preservation and values for TU-games
title_zh: 子博弈序保持与TU博弈的值

abstract: Applied economists routinely compare estimates across specifications, observe that they are "similar," and conclude that their results are "robust." This common procedure makes an implicit inferential claim about the range of estimates, but usually does not account for their joint sampling distribution when the estimates are generated from the same data. I formalize informal practice with two bootstrap statistics that account for the dependence among estimates. The minimum equivalence bound is the smallest tolerance within which the estimates can be judged equivalent. The range-based equality p-value tests whether the estimates are statistically distinguishable. Together they distinguish failure to detect differences from affirmative evidence of agreement. Simulations across a range of designs show approximately correct size and demonstrate that common visual rules often provide false comfort. Applications to five prominent papers using common identification strategies validate some conventional robustness claims while revealing cases in which apparent agreement reflects imprecision rather than stability. In a pre-registered survey of CEPR and NBER affiliates, expert judgments align with the framework in obvious cases but diverge in intermediate cases, where the verdict depends on the joint sampling distribution rather than on the visible spread of point estimates alone. I suggest that the minimum equivalence bound the equality p-value be reported whenever multiple specifications are presented as evidence of robustness.
abstract_zh: 应用经济学家经常比较不同设定下的估计值，观察到它们“相似”，便得出结论认为结果是“稳健的”。这一常见做法隐含了对估计值范围的推断性主张，但通常未考虑当这些估计值源自同一数据集时它们的联合抽样分布。我通过两种自助法统计量将这一非正式实践形式化，这两种统计量考虑了估计值之间的依赖性。最小等价界限是判断估计值可视为等价的最小容差。基于范围的相等性p值检验估计值在统计上是否可区分。两者共同区分了未能检测到差异与对一致性的肯定证据。跨多种设计的模拟显示近似正确的检验规模，并表明常见的视觉规则往往提供虚假的安慰。对采用常见识别策略的五篇重要论文的应用验证了一些传统稳健性主张，同时揭示了表面一致性反映的是不精确性而非稳定性的案例。在一项针对CEPR和NBER会员的预注册调查中，专家判断在明显情况下与框架一致，但在中间情况下出现分歧，此时结论取决于联合抽样分布，而非仅凭点估计的可见离散程度。我建议，在将多个设定作为稳健性证据呈现时，应报告最小等价界限和相等性p值。
title: Robustness? Range Tests for Equality and Equivalence Across Specifications
title_zh: 稳健性？跨设定的相等性与等价性范围检验

abstract: The California dairy industry has experienced considerable consolidation over the past 30 years. During this period, there has also been substantial technological innovation, implementation of the state's Low Carbon Fuel Standard program, and rapid adoption of anaerobic digesters. This apparent correlation has fueled concerns that anaerobic digesters are causing consolidation. We test for a causal relationship between digesters and consolidation using synthetic differences‐in‐differences. Our findings dispute the theory that digesters are causing consolidation.
abstract_zh: 加州乳制品行业在过去30年间经历了显著的整合。在此期间，该行业还出现了大量技术创新、州低碳燃料标准项目的实施，以及厌氧消化器的迅速普及。这种表面上的相关性引发了担忧，认为厌氧消化器正在导致行业整合。我们采用合成双重差分法检验了消化器与整合之间的因果关系。我们的研究结果反驳了消化器导致整合的理论。
title: The Cow or the Credit: Causal Relationship Between California Dairy Herd Consolidation and Anaerobic Digesters
title_zh: 奶牛还是信贷：加州奶牛群整合与厌氧消化器之间的因果关系

abstract: This paper examines the gender differences in labor market integration among refugees and their determinants. It focuses on a longitudinal dataset that covers the entire refugee population in Switzerland over 20 years. During the period examined, the majority of refugees came from low-income economies in Africa and Asia. The quasi-random allocation of asylum seekers across Swiss cantons, which differ in their socio-economic characteristics, provides a natural experiment to identify the effects of source country culture and the role of local initial conditions in shaping refugees’ labor-market integration trajectories. Our empirical findings show that women refugees from countries with more conservative gender norms (measured by female-to-male labor force participation ratios and fertility rates) have less favorable labor market outcomes, with these effects varying in their persistence over time. The analysis further reveals the negative role of initial unemployment and the positive role of co-ethnic networks in the cantons of arrival, with these effects varying by gender and network characteristics. Finally, local attitudes toward gender equality reduce the gender gap in labor market outcomes among refugees.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了难民劳动力市场融入中的性别差异及其决定因素。研究基于一项覆盖瑞士全部难民人口长达20年的纵向数据集。在所考察期间，大多数难民来自非洲和亚洲的低收入经济体。寻求庇护者在社会经济特征各异的瑞士各州之间的准随机分配，为识别来源国文化的影响以及当地初始条件在塑造难民劳动力市场融入轨迹中的作用提供了一个自然实验。我们的实证发现表明，来自性别规范更为保守（以女性与男性劳动力参与率之比和生育率衡量）的国家的女性难民，其劳动力市场结果较为不利，且这些效应在时间上的持续性有所不同。分析进一步揭示了抵达州初始失业率的负面作用以及同族网络的正面作用，且这些效应因性别和网络特征而异。最后，当地对性别平等的态度缩小了难民劳动力市场结果中的性别差距。
title: The gender dimension of refugees’ integration in the labor market
title_zh: 难民融入劳动力市场的性别维度

abstract: Transition risks related to climate change are increasingly recognised in equity and bond markets. This column uses syndicated loan tranches issued to US firms to study how carbon risk is priced. It finds robust evidence that firms with higher carbon intensity face higher loan spreads. However, this carbon premium has declined and effectively disappeared in recent years, though it increases during periods of monetary tightening. Borrowers that signal environmental commitment pay lower loan risk spreads and undertake higher capital and R&D expenditure, but the discount shrinks as carbon intensity rises.
abstract_zh: 与气候变化相关的转型风险在股票和债券市场中日益受到认可。本文利用发放给美国企业的银团贷款批次，研究碳风险如何被定价。研究发现，碳强度较高的企业面临更高的贷款利差，这一证据稳健。然而，这种碳溢价近年来有所下降并实际上消失，尽管在货币紧缩时期会上升。表明环境承诺的借款人支付较低的贷款风险利差，并进行更高的资本和研发支出，但随着碳强度的增加，这一折扣会缩小。
authors: Yao Dong, Martina Hengge, Fabian Valencia, Richard Varghese
title: Carbon risk in loan pricing: Commitment channels and real effects
title_zh: 贷款定价中的碳风险：承诺渠道与实际效应

abstract: Childhood disability significantly impacts family members. Limited by data, prior research has faced challenges in measurement and identification and focused primar- ily on maternal labor outcomes. Utilizing 20-year-long administrative records from Taiwan’s National Health Insurance Research Database, we study cerebral palsy (CP), one of the most prevalent causes of childhood disability. We leverage its unexpected nature and our comprehensive data to investigate a broad spectrum of impacts on family members. Adopting an event study approach, we examine various outcomes, including parental labor supply, mental health, marital status, and fertility. Our find- ings reveal that having a child with CP decreases the mother’s likelihood of employ- ment by 6.2 percentage points (pp), increases the likelihood of divorce by 2.3 pp, and amplifies the risk of depression by 28%. Additionally, there’s a notable decrease in long-term fertility. These effects are more pronounced for parents in poorer socioeco- nomic conditions and for families with daughters who have CP.
abstract_zh: 儿童期残疾对家庭成员产生显著影响。受数据限制，以往研究在测量与识别方面面临挑战，且主要聚焦于母亲的劳动成果。利用台湾国民健康保险研究数据库长达20年的行政记录，我们研究了脑性瘫痪（CP），这是儿童期残疾最常见的病因之一。我们利用其突发性质及全面数据，探讨了对家庭成员的广泛影响。采用事件研究方法，我们考察了多种结果，包括父母的劳动供给、心理健康、婚姻状况及生育情况。研究发现，有脑性瘫痪儿童的家庭中，母亲就业可能性下降6.2个百分点，离婚可能性增加2.3个百分点，抑郁风险增加28%。此外，长期生育率显著下降。这些效应在社会经济条件较差的父母及有脑性瘫痪女儿的家庭中更为明显。
china_relevance_reason: 研究使用台湾全民健康保险研究数据库的行政记录，研究对象为台湾家庭，属于中国地区研究，因此直接相关。
title: Impacts of childhood disability on family: Labor, marriage, fertility, and depression
title_zh: 儿童残疾对家庭的影响：劳动、婚姻、生育与抑郁

abstract: Amid the acceleration of global warming and urbanization, summer heat has become a critical climate hazard that constrains outdoor recreation in megacities. By leveraging high-resolution spatiotemporal mobility data alongside meteorological station observations, we estimate linear mixed effects and quantile regression models to quantify the influences of multiple high-temperature metrics on visits to 234 parks of diverse typologies within the Beijing Sixth Ring Road. High temperatures are shown to decrease park visits by 11–19%. However, once the air temperature exceeds 35 °C, the marginal deterrent effect of heat duration attenuates, indicating a phenomenon of desensitization. Historical and ecological parks, together with weekday visitation, exhibit pronounced rigidity and display limited sensitivity, whereas community, comprehensive and specialized parks and weekend park visits are markedly heat responsive. These findings highlight the scope for urban planning interventions to strengthen thermal resilience. Fostering increased clustering and edge complexity for green space while tempering its connectivity, expanding the proportion of blue space, implementing time-of-day operational zoning in heat-sensitive parks, and providing seamless linkages between parks, shopping malls and metro stations can collectively mitigate heat-induced declines in park use.
abstract_zh: 在全球变暖和城市化进程加速的背景下，夏季高温已成为制约特大城市户外休闲活动的关键气候风险因素。通过利用高分辨率时空移动数据与气象站观测数据相结合，我们估计了线性混合效应模型和分位数回归模型，以量化多种高温指标对北京六环内234个不同类型公园访问量的影响。研究表明，高温使公园访问量减少11%至19%。然而，当气温超过35°C时，高温持续时间的边际威慑效应减弱，呈现出一种脱敏现象。历史名园和生态公园以及工作日访问表现出明显的刚性，敏感性有限，而社区公园、综合公园、专类公园及周末公园访问则对高温反应显著。这些发现凸显了城市规划干预措施在增强热韧性方面的潜力。通过促进绿地聚集度和边缘复杂性的提升，同时适度控制其连通性，扩大蓝色空间占比，在热敏感公园实施分时段运营管理，以及构建公园、购物中心与地铁站之间的无缝衔接，均可共同缓解高温导致的公园使用下降。
china_relevance_reason: 标题、摘要或元数据包含中国相关关键词
title: Enhancing climate adaptation through urban park planning: Modelling high-temperature visitation patterns via big data in Beijing
title_zh: 通过城市公园规划增强气候适应：基于北京大数据的高温访问模式建模

abstract: This paper examines causal peer effects in pro-environmental behavior using geocoded panel data on 260,000 Swiss households from 2008 to 2019 and instrumental variables methods. We find that peer behavior has a simultaneous impact on a broad range of energy-related practices. In particular, we find that peer solar photovoltaic (PV) adoption increases household electricity conservation efforts, with each additional solar PV installation at 100 meters’ distance to a household reducing a household’s annual electricity consumption by 0.2%. We also document peer effects both within and across markets for pro-environmental durable goods, with increased uptake of solar PV and electric vehicles following new solar PV installations nearby. We find suggestive evidence that peer influence manifests itself in different ways contingent upon households’ constraints. Our findings have important implications for renewable energy subsidy evaluation. To illustrate this we calculate the marginal value of public funds (MVPF) of the existing solar PV subsidy scheme. In this setting, accounting for peer effects increases the estimated MVPF by approximately 17%. Previous article in issue Next article in issue
abstract_zh: 本文利用2008年至2019年间26万户瑞士家庭的地理编码面板数据及工具变量方法，考察了亲环境行为中的同伴因果效应。研究发现，同伴行为对一系列与能源相关的实践具有即时影响。具体而言，同伴太阳能光伏（PV）的采用增加了家庭节电努力，每增加一个距离家庭100米范围内的太阳能光伏安装，可使该家庭年用电量减少0.2%。我们还记录了亲环境耐用品市场内及跨市场的同伴效应，即附近新增太阳能光伏安装后，太阳能光伏和电动汽车的采用率随之上升。我们发现了提示性证据，表明同伴影响根据家庭约束条件的不同而以不同方式显现。我们的发现对可再生能源补贴评估具有重要意义。为说明这一点，我们计算了现有太阳能光伏补贴方案的公共资金边际价值（MVPF）。在此情境下，考虑同伴效应会使估算的MVPF增加约17%。
title: Green spills: Peer effects in pro-environmental behaviors
title_zh: 绿色溢出：亲环境行为中的同伴效应
